metadata.name: mom'smelter
metadata.description:
Translation by AI
One-sentence：When no trinket is equipped, the Furnace will spit one out.
When there is no trinket in the bottom-left trinket slot and the player is not holding a trinket above their head, using the Smelter will spawn a trinket (the spawning effect is identical to that of Mom's Box).
Conversely, if there is a trinket in the bottom-left trinket slot or the player is holding a trinket above their head, using the Smelter will consume the trinket (the original Smelter effect remains intact).
Note: The judgment only checks the bottom-left trinket slot and the trinket currently being held above the player's head. Trinkets that have already been consumed do not affect this logic.
Authors: 武珞(Code), Lonely night (Art)
